title: wp-weakness-catalogue
description: manifests/wp-weakness-catalogue.json — the weaknesses bin/wp-posture.mjs evaluates over the typed rows bin/lib/wp-observables.mjs reads from a WordPress tree and, when one is given, a database dump. Each entry is one predicate: an observable `type`, a `verb`, and an optional `where` filter. loadCatalogue() in bin/wp-posture.mjs refuses a verb, type, severity, CWE form, `where` operator, count `than` or unknown route it does not implement; this schema is that same closed vocabulary written once. An entry loadCatalogue refuses is reported as `invalid` in the scan summary, so a shape this schema accepts and the reader refuses (or the reverse) is a finding nobody sees.

name.description: Reported in the scan summary as catalogue.name.

note.description: What the catalogue is and how a predicate is written. Read by people, not by the scanner.

routes.description: Keyed by route id; each value says what the route reaches. An entry's `enables` must name a key here, which loadCatalogue checks and this JSON Schema subset cannot express.

componentClasses.description: Keyed by class name. classify() in bin/lib/wp-observables.mjs tags a component with every class whose `slugs` contains its slug or whose `nameRegex` matches its display name, so a row's `classes` is the sorted list of these keys.

slugs.description: Plugin or theme directory slugs that are in this class.

nameRegex.description: Case-insensitive pattern over a component's display name.

id.description: Rule id, reported with every finding. loadCatalogue also refuses a duplicate.

name.description: Human name, reported with each finding and in the passed list.

verb.description: exists: one finding per matching row, capped. absent: one finding when no row matches. count-gt/count-lt: one finding when the match count crosses `than`.

type.description: The observable type the predicate counts. bin/lib/wp-observables.mjs is the owner of this list (TYPES).

where.description: An AND over row fields. A field takes a scalar (equality), a list (membership) or an operator object.

additionalProperties.description: Scalar equality, list membership, or an operator object (every operator in it must match).

given.description: Precondition: no matching row makes the entry not applicable, an unmeasured given.type makes it not measured.

additionalProperties.description: Scalar equality, list membership, or an operator object (every operator in it must match).

than.description: The count a count-gt or count-lt verb compares against. loadCatalogue refuses a count verb without a finite `than`; the keyword needed to say that here (if/then) is not implemented by lib/json-schema.mjs.

detail.description: Template reported with each finding. {field} is substituted from the matching row, plus {count} and {than}.

enables.description: Route ids, each a key of `routes`.

guideline.description: The public guideline item the entry follows. Carried for readers; the scanner does not dereference it.

course.description: Remediation prose, reported with each finding.
